title: 第1章 铁盒子
content_zh:
结束这次的旅行，回到略显清冷的家中，放下背包，先将自己扔进沙发中的左晓瑶闭目呆了近半个小时后，才拿起电话叫份外卖送过来。

直到吃饱睡好，旅途疲劳消去大半后，神清气爽的起床换上家居常服，去洗手间简单梳洗过一番的左晓瑶这才有心思查看这次的旅行收获。

这是次意义并不普通的旅行，她希望能完成奶奶后来一直没能实现的愿望，她期待天堂里的奶奶能随她一起经历这次旅行，带着满心的眷恋，旅行时的左晓瑶并没有游玩的心思，自然也谈不上带回什么特产。

除带去带回的行礼、几幅已完成的画及数码相机中的大量图片外，还有一只虽锈迹斑斑，却还保存得相当完好的铁盒子，比巴掌大不了多少，被一个极为小巧的铜锁锁住，若无钥匙，想要打开，还需费一番功夫。

“奶奶，您看，这些都是x城和x镇的景色，有些地方还很漂亮，和您说得差不多，就是也有很多您说很漂亮的地方都已经大变样了！您若亲眼看到这些，不知会有什么的感觉，会不会很失望呢？”

“还好，您说的那间寺庙还在，就是更破旧了些，还被设成景点了，那石台阶爬起来可真累人，多亏您和爷爷当初藏的那个盒子还在那个石壁缝里，不然，我多不划算啊！”

“.....不过那地可真难发现，真不知道您们当初怎么那有闲心，整得还挺浪漫！您瞧，连这石头，池塘，石台阶，我都给拍下来了.....”

边翻看着相机中拍下的奶奶家乡的图片，嘴角含着抹浅笑的左晓瑶流着眼泪对一室清冷的空气喃声自语道。

看罢相片，抬手捂住眼睛的左晓瑶一遍遍在脑海中想像着奶奶若在，若能看到这些图片时的反应。

想必定会指着每张图片给自己介绍那里过去的样子，她曾与爷爷在那里讲过什么，有多开心吧！

深吸了口气，放下手后，抬头看了眼沙发正对面的墙壁上挂着那张只有她与奶奶两人的‘全家福’，左晓瑶取出拴着根红绳，挂在她脖子上的那把极为小巧的铜钥匙摩挲了下两下道“奶奶，这盒子里有些什么东西，您为什么不先告诉我呢？您不说，我就把它拿去找人问问，要是很值钱，我就把它卖了，到时候啥都不用干，天天吃香的喝辣的，反正您说是给我的嫁妆！要是不值钱，那我就....勉强留下来吧！”

身为刚出生几天就被丢在路边的弃婴，左晓瑶是被捡到她的奶奶养大的，奶奶中年丧夫，辛苦拉扯大的唯一儿子也在三十多年前的那个特殊年代落水身亡，连个尸体都没找到、

二十二年来，祖孙二人相依为命，她大学毕业不足一年，年近八旬的奶奶便因病离世，对左晓瑶而言，这绝对是她有生以来所遇到的最大打击。

无论生活再贫困，条件再艰难，因身份的特殊，即便从小饱受同龄人的疏远，早熟的她一直都能挺直脊背笑着面对，有奶奶所给予的足够多的爱，她觉得这世间没有任何困难可以压得倒她，因此，奶奶一直是她的精神支柱，也是从不在人前示弱的她唯一能无理撒娇倾诉的对象。

小心打开奶奶临终前才告诉她的这个盒子，即便嘴里说着调皮话，看到这个其貌不扬的盒子中装的‘嫁妆’，同时也是爷爷当年送给奶奶的聘礼中她最喜欢的三样东西，小心捧着这一只镜子、一把篦子梳和一根发钗，左晓瑶再次忍不住放声大哭，这是自将奶奶的骨灰送到爷爷的墓边安葬后，她第一次哭得如此毫无顾忌。

已将奶奶教会的坚强刻进骨子里的左晓瑶知道，这将是她最后一次放任自己如此深切的为奶奶的逝去而悲伤，从今以后，只会将这份怀念永远放在心里，不会再像之前的这段时间一样，如行尸走肉般的沉浸在自己的世界中，时时幻想着奶奶仍与她好好的生活在一起。

好好的活，活得好好好的！这是左晓瑶答应奶奶的最后一个心愿，她一定会实现，一定！

正坐在店中办公桌后戴着老花镜看书的老先生闻声抬头，入目所见的是位背着个双肩包刚走进店门的长发女孩，年龄在二十岁出头，正笑吟吟的与他打招呼，显然是熟人，他下意识的笑着回道“哦，是晓瑶来了，可有段时间没见你了！”

说到这里略顿了一下后，这位看起来六十多岁的老者神情一肃的接着道“你奶奶的事，你要节哀顺变，要想开些才好，上次我就说过，今后若有什么需要帮忙的事，尽管来找我或?j佳她爸妈，我们可不是外人！”

在老者提到她奶奶的那一瞬间，笑容略顿的晓瑶虽神情微黯，只是随后就笑着感谢道“谢谢王爷爷，多亏有您和王叔叔、赵阿姨帮忙，奶奶的后事才会办得那么顺利，您别担心，我知道奶奶也希望我能生活得快乐，而不是沉浸在她离开的伤痛中，所以，我不会一直停留在过去，不愿面对这个现实的。”

老者满意的点头感叹道“你这孩子从小就懂事，是啊，你奶奶最大的心愿就是看着你好好的，这几年，你虽有些太过辛苦，却也争气得很，不仅让她安享晚年，到了，走得也安详，不枉她含辛茹苦的把你拉扯大。”

说起这些，气氛难免有些伤感，接连眨了几下眼睛后，左晓瑶才笑着回道“王爷爷说得也是，除了有些遗憾没看到我嫁人生子外，奶奶还说要感谢上帝愿召她前去与爷爷和叔叔团聚，总算让她如愿以偿了呢！而我，心里再不是滋味，也得笑着祝福天堂里的她和爷爷、叔叔过得更幸福不是！”

除将她养大却已逝去的奶奶外，没有人，能比亲眼看着她长大的老者更清楚眼前这?c弱的女孩骨子里有多坚强，除当事人外，也没有人能比他更清楚这对相依为命的祖孙二人间的感情有多深厚，哪怕这个刚走出大学校园不足一年的年轻女孩此时笑容灿烂，他却能一眼看得出女孩那隐藏在笑容背后的眼泪。

不想再继续这个伤感的话题，老者端起茶壶准备泡茶道“你先坐，这段时间跑哪去了呢，听?j佳抱怨，你辞掉先前那份工作突然跑外地去了，找不到你人，打你手机，又总是信号不好，说不了几句就断线。”

“您别忙，还是我来吧，之前去p城转了圈，以前奶奶在时，也曾想过要带她一起出去走走，可她身体好的时候，我没那能力，等有条件了，她却经不得折腾，如今她虽不在了，我就替她再回去看看，反正哪怕她去了天堂，也不会忘了时常看看我，说起来，我俩这也算是另类同游方式！”

接过老者手中的茶壶熟门熟路的取好茶叶泡上的同时，左晓瑶边笑着坦然解释道，虽知道老者转移话题的好意，但她并不觉得与奶奶有关的话题需要回避，哪怕现在每提一次，她都会觉得心痛一下，但她却从没打算逃避这个现实。

p城是奶奶的故乡，自嫁给爷爷后，她就极少再有机会离开s城，回故乡的次数屈指可数，她虽未说，但从她多次对自己讲起故乡时的眷念中，晓瑶知道那不仅是她与爷爷当年定情的地方，同时也是她从不曾忘怀的地方，即便那里早已人事全非，这也是一个执念。

无语的苦笑着摇了摇头后，喝了口左晓瑶递给他的茶，老者一脸了然的道“说吧，今天来，有什么事吗？别说特意来看我这老头子，我不信!”

左晓瑶一脸郁闷的道“王爷爷这话说得太伤人心了吧，过去我可没少特意来看您啊！”

“得了，你那点小心思，我还不知道，要是没事，你什么时候踏过这个门！你要想特意看望我，肯定去家了，顺便对?j佳她爸妈说，你是去特意看他们的！”

有那么明显吗！在心中暗自反省自己哪回做得太不谨慎，竟在这老者面前穿了帮的同时，左晓瑶笑得颇有些讨好的转移话题道“那还不是因为我常来这里专门看您，去家里看叔叔阿姨的次数倒比较少！虽然今天主要是来看望王爷爷，不过我顺道又带了几幅画来，请您老帮忙品鉴一二！”

提到画，神情一振的老者显然很有兴趣“算了，算了，我就从没说赢过你！快把画拿出来，让我看看你的画技最近有长进了没！”

随着她在这次旅行中随意画的四幅画被分别展开，老者在一一看过的同时，分别对其做出相当中肯的点评之后，才不无遗憾的道“不错，真不错！我一直觉得你具有很高的绘画天赋，过去在学校任教的那些年里，也见过不少具有天赋的孩子，却也从没一人能在这个年龄画出这种水平的作品，哪怕有些早已顶着青年画家的名头到处开画展，而你却.....唉.....说起来，我就....”

并未因老者这位教授级的艺术大师如此高看自己的作品而面露喜色，左晓瑶只是浅笑着道“得，得了，多谢王教授的夸奖！您可别再夸了，我的情况，您可是再清楚不过了的，想当年，我可在还不识字前，就开始拿棍棒在地上乱描乱画，奶奶是您师娘，她的水平您也是知道的，有您和奶奶这两位高人指点，我又画了近二十年，即便再没天分，我也勤能补拙了！”
content_en:
After finishing this trip, she returned to her slightly cold home, put down her backpack, and threw herself into the sofa. Zuo Xiaoyao closed her eyes for nearly half an hour before picking up the phone and ordering a takeaway.

After eating well and sleeping well, most of the fatigue from the journey was gone, Zuo Xiaoyao got up refreshed, put on her home clothes, and went to the bathroom to freshen up briefly. Only then did Zuo Xiaoyao think about the harvest of this trip.

This was a trip of extraordinary significance. She hoped to fulfill her grandma's wish that she had never been able to realize. She expected her grandma in heaven to experience this trip with her. With her heart full of nostalgia, Zuo Xiaoyao had no intention of having fun during the trip, and naturally she could not bring back any special products.

In addition to the gifts brought back, several completed paintings and a large number of pictures from the digital camera, there was also a rusty but well-preserved iron box, not much bigger than a palm, locked by an extremely small copper lock. Without a key, it would take a lot of effort to open it.

"Grandma, look, these are the scenery of x city and x town. Some places are still very beautiful, just like what you said, but many of the places you said are beautiful have changed drastically! If you saw these with your own eyes, how would you feel? Would you be very disappointed?"

"Fortunately, the temple you mentioned is still there, but it is more dilapidated and has been set up as a tourist attraction. It is really tiring to climb up those stone steps. Fortunately, the box you and grandpa hid in the beginning is still in the crack of the stone wall. Otherwise, it would be a waste for me!"

"...But that place is really hard to find. I really don't know why you were so leisurely and romantic in the first place! You see, I even took photos of the rocks, ponds, and stone steps..."

While looking at the pictures of grandma's hometown taken on the camera, Zuo Xiaoyao, with a smile on her face, shed tears and murmured to herself in the cold air of the room.

After looking at the photos, Zuo Xiaoyao raised her hands to cover her eyes, imagining her grandma's reaction over and over again if she were here and could see these pictures.

I guess she would point to each picture to introduce to herself what it used to be like there, and what she and her grandfather had talked about there. How happy she must be!

Taking a deep breath, after putting down her hands, she looked up at the 'family portrait' of just her and her grandmother hanging on the wall directly opposite the sofa. Zuo Xiaoyao took out the extremely small copper key hanging on a red string around her neck, rubbed it twice and said, "Grandma, what's in this box?""Why don't you tell me first? If you don't tell me, I'll take it to ask someone. If it's valuable, I'll sell it. Then I won't have to do anything, and I'll enjoy it every day. Anyway, you said it's a dowry for me! If it's not valuable, then I'll just... keep it!"

As an abandoned baby who was abandoned on the roadside just a few days after she was born, Zuo Xiaoyao was raised by her grandmother who found her. Her grandmother lost her husband in middle age, and the only son she had raised through hard work also fell into the water and died in that special era more than thirty years ago. Not even a body was found.

For twenty-two years, the grandfather and grandson have been dependent on each other. Less than a year after she graduated from college, her grandmother, who was nearly eighty years old, passed away due to illness. For Zuo Xiaoyao, this was definitely the biggest blow she had ever encountered in her life.

No matter how poor her life is, how difficult her conditions are, even if she has been alienated from her peers since childhood due to her special status, the precocious girl has always been able to face it with a straight back and a smile. With enough love from her grandma, she feels that no difficulty in the world can overwhelm her. Therefore, her grandma has always been her spiritual support and the only person she can unreasonably confide in, who never shows weakness in front of others.

Carefully opening the box that her grandma told her before she died, even though she said naughty words, she saw that the 'dowry' contained in this humble box was also her three favorite things among the betrothal gifts given to her by her grandfather. Carefully holding the mirror, a comb and a hairpin, Zuo Xiaoyao could not help but burst into tears again. This was the first time she had cried so unscrupulously since she sent her grandma's ashes to her grandfather's grave for burial.

Zuo Xiaoyao, who has engraved the strength taught by her grandma into her bones, knows that this will be the last time she allows herself to grieve so deeply for the passing of her grandma. From now on, she will only keep this memory in her heart forever, and will no longer be immersed in her own world like a zombie like the previous period, always imagining that her grandma is still living well with her.

Live well, live well!This is the last wish that Zuo Xiaoyao promised her grandma. She will definitely realize it, definitely!

The old man who was sitting behind the desk in the store and reading a book with reading glasses looked up when he heard the sound. What he saw was a long-haired girl who had just walked into the store with a backpack on her back. She was in her early twenties. She was greeting him with a smile. She was obviously an acquaintance. He subconsciously smiled and replied, "Oh, it's Xiaoyao here, but I haven't seen you for a while!"

After pausing for a moment, the old man who looked to be in his sixties continued with a solemn expression, "As for your grandma, you have to be considerate and considerate, and you have to be open-minded. I said last time that if you need help with anything in the future, just come to me or her parents, we are not outsiders!"

The moment the old man mentioned her grandma, Xiaoyao, who smiled for a moment, looked dim, but then smiled and thanked her, "Thank you, Grandpa Wang. Thanks to your help, Uncle Wang, and Aunt Zhao, grandma's funeral will be so smooth. Don't worry, I know grandma also hopes that I can live a happy life instead of being immersed in the pain of her departure, so I will not stay in the past and be unwilling to face this reality."

The old man nodded with satisfaction and sighed, "You have been sensible since you were a child. Yes, your grandma's biggest wish is to see you well. In the past few years, although you have worked too hard, you have been very successful. Not only did you let her enjoy her old age in peace, but she also passed away peacefully. It was not in vain that she worked hard to bring you up."

Speaking of this, the atmosphere was inevitably a little sad. After blinking a few times, Zuo Xiaoyao replied with a smile, "Grandpa Wang is right. In addition to being a little regretful about not seeing me get married and have children, grandma also said she wanted to thank God for calling her to reunite with her grandpa and uncle. She finally got her wish! And no matter how uncomfortable I feel in my heart, I have to smile and wish her, grandpa, and uncle in heaven a happier life!"

Except for the grandmother who raised her but passed away, no one can know better than the old man who watched her grow up how strong the weak girl in front of him was. Except for the person involved, no one can know better than him how deep the relationship between the grandfather and grandson who depended on each other was. Even though this young girl who had just stepped out of college less than a year ago was smiling brightly, he could see the tears hidden behind the girl's smile at a glance.

Not wanting to continue this sad topic, the old man picked up the teapot and prepared to make a tea ceremony. "You sit down first. Where have you been during this time? Listen to J Jia's complaint. You quit your previous job and suddenly ran away. I can't find you. When I call your mobile phone, the signal is always poor. After a few words, the connection is disconnected."

"Don't be busy, I'll do it. I went to P City before. When grandma was here, I thought about taking her out for a walk. But when she was in good health, I didn't have the ability. When conditions permit, she can't stand it. Now that she is gone, I will go back and visit for her. Anyway, even if she goes to heaven, she will never forget to see me from time to time. Speaking of which, this is a different way for us to travel together!"

Taking the teapot from the old man's hand and taking the tea leaves to steep in a familiar manner, Zuo Xiaoyao smiled and explained calmly that although she knew the old man's good intentions in changing the subject, she did not feel that the topic related to her grandma needed to be avoided. Even though she felt heartbroken every time it was mentioned now, she never intended to escape this reality.

P city is her grandma's hometown. After marrying her grandfather, she rarely had the chance to leave S city. She only returned to her hometown a handful of times. Although she didn't say it, from the nostalgia of her hometown when she told her many times, Xiaoyao knew that it was not only the place where she and her grandfather fell in love, but it was also a place that she had never forgotten. Even though everything there had been completely changed, this was still an obsession.

After shaking his head with a speechless wry smile, he took a sip of the tea Zuo Xiaoyao handed him. The old man said with a clear face, "Tell me, what's the matter with coming today? Don't tell me that you came here to see me, an old man, I don't believe you!"

Zuo Xiaoyao said with a depressed look, "Grandpa Wang's words are so hurtful. I've often come to see you in the past!"

"Come on, I don't know about your little thoughts. If nothing happens, when will you step through this door! If you want to visit me specially, you must have gone home. By the way, tell Jijia's parents that you went to see them specially!"

Is it that obvious?While secretly reflecting on the time when he was too imprudent and actually betrayed himself in front of the old man, Zuo Xiaoyao smiled rather flatteringly and changed the subject: "That's not because I often come here to see you. I go home to see my uncle and aunt less often! Although today I mainly came to visit Grandpa Wang, but I brought a few paintings along the way. Please help me taste them!"

When it came to painting, the perky old man was obviously very interested. "Forget it, forget it, I never said I beat you! Take out the painting quickly and let me see if your painting skills have improved recently!"

As the four paintings she randomly drew during this trip were unfolded, the old man looked at them one by one and made quite pertinent comments on them, and then said with regret, "Not bad, really good! I have always felt that you have a high talent for painting. I used to teach at the school.In those years, I have seen many talented children, but no one has ever been able to draw works of this level at this age. Even some of them have already held art exhibitions in the name of young painters, but you...sigh... Speaking of which, I just..."

Zuo Xiaoyao did not show joy because the old man, a professor-level art master, thought so highly of his work. Zuo Xiaoyao just smiled and said, "Okay, okay, thank you Professor Wang for the compliment! Please stop praising me. You know my situation very well. I remember back then.", before I could read, I started drawing on the ground with a stick. Grandma is your master, and you know her level. With the guidance of you and grandma, I have been drawing for nearly twenty years. Even if I have no talent, I can still make up for my shortcomings!"
